metadata.description:
PawPlan is the companion app built specifically for first-time dog parents in Sydney, Australia.

From keeping track of vaccinations and vet appointments to discovering off-leash dog beaches in Rose Bay and Sirius Cove, PawPlan brings clarity and calm to dog care.

KEY FEATURES:

• TODAY DASHBOARD: Your dog's daily care at a glance. Track walks, meals, medications, and hydration scores with one tap.

• SMART SCHEDULE & RECURRENCE: Set up recurring routines (daily, weekdays, weekends) with automated rescheduling and push reminders.

• HEALTH & MEDICAL HUB: Track weight history, log vaccinations, record vet appointments, and store important health milestones.

• SYDNEY DOG PLACES: Curated directory of Sydney's best off-leash dog beaches, fenced parks, dog-friendly cafes, and 24/7 emergency veterinary hospitals (SASH, UVTHS, ARH) with instant one-tap calling and navigation.

• PUPPY ACADEMY: A structured 12-week development guide covering essential puppy milestones, socialization windows, and foundation commands.

• EXPENSE TRACKER & BUDGETING: Keep pet expenses organized across food, vet care, grooming, and gear. Set monthly budgets and export itemized CSV reports.

• DOCUMENT VAULT: Securely store digital records of microchip registration, NSW Pet Registry IDs, desexing certificates, and pet insurance policies.

• NSW PET REGULATIONS: Essential NSW Companion Animals Act guidance, council registration deadlines, and leash laws at your fingertips.

• MULTI-DOG SUPPORT: Seamlessly switch profiles to manage multiple furry family members.

• 100% PRIVATE & ON-DEVICE: Your data stays on your device with Apple Core Data. Zero tracking, zero third-party ads.

Happy paws. Every day.

app_review_information.demo_account_notes: No login credentials required. The app includes pre-seeded demonstration dog profiles (Archie and Bella) showcasing all features immediately upon launch.
